reason: The five-coefficient series viscous/inertial resistance balance is the most parsimonious physically explicit candidate, with exact sealed-valve behavior and a bounded small-drop relaxation rate that is safe for the required 5 s RK4 integration. Its training-only validation RMSE was 0.0387076 bar and its joint-fit supplied-data RMSE is approximately 0.032312 bar. The slightly more flexible alternatives improve supplied-data RMSE only modestly; all retain substantial correlated residuals and no independent validation remains after the final refit. This recommendation weights interpretability, numerical relaxation stability and restrained extrapolation over a small in-sample fit advantage.
